stage: Exploratory mechanism audit followed by frozen official-validation replication
motivation: Conventional classifiers on DDXPlus are not novel. Identify which features of the published generator support explain disease-label identifiability.
initial_observation: Official test, all 134529: true disease compatible with all observed evidence IDs in release_conditions.json in 100%; unique compatible disease in 124397 (92.4685%). This observation preceded this protocol.
rule: Candidate set C(E) = intersection over recorded evidence e of {d: e in symptoms(d) union antecedents(d)}. No patient training labels, answer values, likelihoods, age, sex, or differential scores used in this rule.
frozen_replication: Apply the exact rule to all official validate.csv rows, including separately excluding previously analyzed validation IDs and exact fact sets occurring in test or sampled training. No threshold tuning.
audits: minimum certificates of size at most 3, counted exactly
selective accuracy and coverage, not tie-breaking accuracy
metadata-consistency audit in all official train/validate/test rows
reference differential probability mass outside the hard generator-compatible set
exact support-compatible vs incompatible candidates in source differential
all-binary versus symptoms-only versus antecedents-only rules
background-feature addition as explicitly artificial out-of-support stress, not a clinical counterfactual
interpretation: The metadata is diagnostic knowledge and part of the generator; no patient training does not mean no prior knowledge. A disease-evidence edge absent from the catalog is treated as impossible ONLY for the simulator audit, not as clinical impossibility. Reference differentials are rule-based outputs, not guaranteed generator posteriors. Their disagreement does not establish that their clinical judgment is wrong.
success_criterion: Reproducible support-based identifiability on official validation, short certificates, explicit limits, and novelty comparison. No promise of major discovery.
